simple_explanation: 'Far and Near' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: 55 ChapterChapter Far and Near Identify the appropriate units for measuring each of the following.
We have learnt about measuring length and some standard units we use to measure length.
In this chapter we will learn some more units of measuring distances and the relationships between different units.
